note: One row = ONE interaction where BOTH a TradingView observation AND a UCT observation exist. note: ⛔ UNRESOLVED. UCT's DrawingQuickBar (Style/Duplicate/Lock/Delete) is coarse-pointer-gated and could not be reached through the harness. TV's floating properties toolbar is native-verified.

note: TV binds: an alert on a trendline tracks the line, so moving the line moves the alert. This is the real, surviving alert gap — a semantics gap, not a missing feature. ⚠️ TIER NOTE ADDED AFTER ADVERSARIAL REVIEW: UCT's side was measured ONLY in the 390px fine-pointer frame and was never reproduced on the device, because no drawing could be placed there at all (CMP-041/042/048). UCT's phone renders NO layout door: the template lists are computed two lines above the isMobile return and used only on desktop.

note: ⛔ CORRECTS AN EARLIER WORKING NOTE. UCT syncs the whole tracings document — including the ACTIVE sheet — to the server, on the phone as well as the desktop.

note: Both replace the chart with a peer surface and return. TV: hub → Symbol details → four context tabs. UCT: Tools → a widget page (Fundamentals, Theme Tracker, AI Search, Watchlist), which returns to the chart automatically when the chart's symbol moves.

interaction: Minimum tap-target compliance on the phone CHART SHELL
note: ⛔ WITHDRAWN AND REVERSED BY ADVERSARIAL REVIEW 2026-09-08. This row previously read BROKEN/HIGH on 'three price-scale controls at 17x11px — a quarter of the 44px house minimum'. Those controls are `.scaleToggle`, and StockChart.module.css:778-797 sets them to display:none on the phone chart shell at coarse pointer, portrait AND landscape. THEY DO NOT RENDER ON A PHONE. The 17x11px measurement came from the fine-pointer 390px frame, where the shell branch does not apply. The watchlist sort controls remain a genuine defect and are already counted at CMP-013. ⭐ Fourth false negative produced by the fine-pointer lane, and the second where UCT had DELIBERATELY solved the problem and the harness could not see it.

interaction: Voice-assistant affordance placement on a phone
note: UCT-only surface: the floating voice orb is clipped at 390px and collides with chart chrome. No TV equivalent exists, so this is a UCT defect measured against nothing — kept in the ledger because it is a real phone defect on the charting surface.

interaction: Whether the OHLC crosshair legend renders AT ALL on a member's phone
note: ⭐ FOUND BY THE ADVERSARIAL REVIEW, AND IT IS A BETTER FINDING THAN THE ONE IT REPLACES. The legend's render gate is `crosshairData && !hideLegend && legendMode !== 'off' && (legendMode !== 'hold' || legendHeld)` (StockChart.jsx:14983-14984) — THERE IS NO POINTER CLAUSE. `legendMode` is a USER SETTING with three states (always/hold/off, chart/legendMode.js), and its own module says the legacy boolean `header.showLegend` 'sits in every stored blob in production' as a read-only fallback. So a fresh sandbox admin resolves the 'always' default and shows OHLC, while a production account carrying a legacy blob can resolve 'off' or 'hold' and show NONE. ⛔ THIS IS THE REAL CAUSE of the earlier 'UCT has no O/H/L/C' observation (UCT-CHART-0005) — an ACCOUNT/SETTINGS difference, not a pointer difference. ⛔ AND IT MEANS A REAL UCT PHONE USER MAY SEE NO OHLC READOUT AT ALL, with the control to fix it buried in chart settings. TradingView's value-tracking legend is not user-disableable in the same way.
